options.rationale: Correct: profit is maximised where marginal revenue equals marginal cost.
Maximum total revenue ignores costs and does not maximise profit.
Minimum average cost does not generally maximise profit.
This is not the profit-maximising condition.

items.stem: If a good has inelastic demand and its price rises, total revenue will:

options.rationale: Correct: with inelastic demand, quantity falls proportionally less than price rises, so revenue increases.
Revenue falls when demand is elastic, not inelastic.
Revenue is constant only with unit elasticity.
Quantity demanded falls only slightly, so revenue does not vanish.

items.explanation: Correct: with inelastic demand, quantity falls proportionally less than price rises, so revenue increases.
